title: AnalyticsRepository
responsibility: Persist analytics events in a private Bun SQLite database.

inputs.name: AnalyticsRepository.constructor.home
inputs.description: Optional database directory; defaults to HARNESS_ANALYTICS_HOME or the user's .codex/harness directory.

inputs.name: record and recordImported.event
inputs.description: Event ID, timestamp and serialized data to persist.

inputs.name: reconcileHistorical.root and project
inputs.description: Source path and canonical project identity for removing stale historical rows.

outputs.name: constructor
outputs.description: Creates a private directory and database, loads the Bun SQLite builtin lazily, sets busy timeout and WAL, and initializes schema version 1. Loading the module does not open a database; Node does not provide bun:sqlite.

outputs.name: record
outputs.description: Inserts an event if its ID is not already present.

outputs.name: recordImported
outputs.description: Upserts imported event data and preserves a previously non-historical classification.

outputs.name: events
outputs.description: Returns stored JSON events ordered by timestamp and insertion order.

outputs.name: reconcileHistorical
outputs.description: Removes historical rows for a resolved previous root when it differs from the canonical project.

errors.name: SQLite or filesystem failure
errors.description: Propagates missing Bun SQLite, unsupported newer schema, filesystem and database failures; WAL setup is retried up to its existing limit.
